cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a quiet memorial hall aboard a starship — kneeling on the ground; an indoor book cafe with a gentle sloping carpeted reading ramp — sliding playfully down the low reading ramp on a wide seat cushion; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — standing; a small botanical conservatory hosting a playful public reading event — performing the finale of a story as an imaginary deep-sea cartographer; the top of a restored ancient city wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a neon-lit game arcade — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds a folding fan open near her chest; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her front; a city rooftop party under string lights — standing; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — holds her keepsake up beside her face
